Prospective Graduate Engineering Students
The GRE requirement has been waived for all engineering master’s applicants. PhD applicants can apply for a GRE waiver here.
Starting Fall 2027 semester there will be a limited number of application fee waivers for PhD applicants.
APPLY AT FAMU
APPLY AT FSU
One College, two universities, unlimited opportunity.
The FAMU-FSU College of Engineering, established in 1982, is the joint engineering school for Florida A&M and Florida State University students. Located in Tallahassee, FL our college is a unique partnership between a top HBCU and Tier 1 research university. Prospective graduate students should explore and research both institutions, then determine to which institution they wish to apply through. All graduate curriculum and research opportunities are mirrored at the joint-college, therefore, no matter which institution you choose to attend, your experience in the classroom and laboratory will be identical.

Why Us?
World-Class Research Centers
Some of the world's most advanced engineering research centers are within walking distance of our classrooms. As a graduate student, you'll immerse yourself in innovative research and discover solutions that help benefit society.
Research Facilities
Competitive Funding Opportunities
We offer competitive funding packages to qualified PhD applicants. These awards include tuition waivers, generous stipends, and health insurance subsidies. These are awarded on a department and faculty basis so reach out to your department and faculty in your research area for more info.
Graduate Funding Opportunities
Multicultural Learning Environment
The partnership between a top HBCU and Tier-1 research university gives you the unique opportunity to work in cross-cultural teams while experiencing stimulating research and collaborating with faculty.
Departments and Programs
With five departments and one interdisciplinary program offering both master's and doctoral degrees, we know there is a program that will help you fulfill your educational and career goals. We also offer two brand new online masters programs!

Frequently Asked Questions
Do I need to apply to both FSU and FAMU?
No, you only need to submit an application through one university. FAMU-FSU College of Engineering is a joint college shared by two universities, Florida A&M University and Florida State University. The program and coursework will be the same no matter which university you apply through. However, upon completion of the degree, you will only earn a diploma from one university.
Do I need to send official transcripts and/or test scores?
University policy allows for application review with unofficial transcripts and test scores. Official transcripts and test scores are required prior to completion of the term in which you have been admitted. Official Transcripts must be sent directly either by mail or electronically from the institution to FAMU or FSU University Admissions offices. Official Test Scores must be sent through ETS to each University. Failure to turn in official documents will result in a registration hold.
FAMU applicants may email their unofficial transcripts and test score sheets to recruit@eng.famu.fsu.edu in order to have them added to their application. They cannot upload to their application on their own.
FSU Applicants can upload their unofficial transcripts and self-report their test scores through their Online Status Page.
Can you waive the application fee?
Starting for the Fall 2027 semester PhD applicants can apply for the application fee to be waived. Please see the Graduate Application Fee Waiver Process to learn more.
What is the cost of tuition?
FAMU tuition and fees can be found by visiting https://famu.edu/students/office-of-financial-aid/cost-of-attendance/index.php. FSU tuition and fees can be found by visiting https://studentbusiness.fsu.edu/tuition-fees. Additional information about graduate funding opportunities can be found by visiting https://www.eng.famu.fsu.edu/prospective/graduate/funding.
Can I waive the GRE requirement?
The GRE has automatically been waived for master’s applicants. Additionally, highly qualified doctoral applicants may be eligible to waive the GRE. Please view the GRE Waiver Request form to review the eligibility requirements.
Can I waive the English Language Proficiency requirement?
The English Language Proficiency requirement can be waived, at the University-level, for applicants who have earned a minimum of a bachelor’s degree or higher in the US or in an English-Speaking Country.
Countries Exempt from English Language Proficiency Requirement:
Anguilla, Antigua & Barbuda, Australia, Barbados, Bahamas, Belize, Bermuda, Botswana, British Virgin Islands, Cameroon, Canada, Cayman Islands, Christmas Islands, Cocos (Keeling Island), Cook Islands, Dhekelia, Dominica, Eritrea, Eswatini, Falkland Islands, Fiji, Gambia, Ghana, Gibraltar, Grenada, Guam, Guernsey, Guyana, Ireland, Isle of Man, Jamaica, Jersey, Kenya, Kiribati, Lesotho, Liberia, Malawi, Malta, Marshall Islands, Micronesia, Montserrat, New Zealand, Nigeria, Niue, Norfolk Island, North Marianas, Palau, Papua New Guinea, Philippines, Pitcairn Islands, Puerto Rico, St. Helena, Ascension, and Tristan da Cunha, St. Kitts and Nevis, St. Lucia, St. Vincent & the Grenadines, Seychelles, Sierra Leone, Singapore, Sint Maarten, South Africa, South Sudan, Sudan, Swaziland, Tanzania, Trinidad and Tobago, Tonga, Tuvalu, Turks and Caicos Islands, Uganda, United Kingdom, US Virgin Islands, Vanuatu, Zambia, Zimbabwe
Where can international students find more information regarding the I-20 process?
Shortly after admission, students will receive an email with instructions for completing the online I-20 application to demonstrate proof of adequate funding. US higher education institutions are required by U.S. federal regulations to verify the financial resources of each applicant prior to issuing the Form I-20. Applicants must show proof of financial support for the first year of study and confirm the availability of funds for the length of the academic program.
For more information, FAMU applicants may contact the Office of International Education and Development (Ms. Rana Ibrahim) at rana.ibrahim@famu.edu or visit https://www.famu.edu/students/international-education-and-development/recruitment-and-admissions/request-the-i-20-form.php.
For more information, FSU applicants may contact the Center for Global Engagement at CGE-NewStudents@fsu.edu or visit https://cge.fsu.edu/international-students/new-students.
